name: R Systems International Limited
summary: R Systems International Limited, established in Greater Noida, India, in 1993, operates as a specialized digital product engineering firm. The company focuses on the comprehensive design and development of software products and platforms, covering everything from low-level chip functionalities to advanced cloud-based solutions. Alongside its core information technology and business process outsourcing services, R Systems delivers a wide array of specialized offerings. Its modernization solutions encompass revitalizing legacy systems, facilitating seamless cloud transitions, implementing hyper-automation strategies, and providing managed services, all powered by robust data and artificial intelligence capabilities. The company's expertise in Cloud and DevOps spans critical areas such as cloud migration and optimization, secure development operations (DevSecOps), cloud operations management (CloudOps), financial governance for cloud (FinOps), Internet of Things (IoT) integration, adherence to AWS well-architected principles, and cutting-edge disaster recovery-as-a-service (DRaaS) models incorporating chaos engineering. Further expanding its engineering prowess, R Systems provides in-depth data and AI services, ranging from strategic data architecture and modernizing data stacks to advanced generative AI, business intelligence, data product development, machine learning operations (MLOps), and agentic AI. It also specializes in embedded firmware, including low-level system development, middleware, application engineering, and comprehensive pre and post-silicon verification and validation. Quality engineering is a foundational aspect of its work, featuring extensive system, API, backend, and user acceptance testing, alongside specialized protocols, test automation, performance optimization, and its proprietary TOP testing suite. The company also crafts engaging mobile user experiences and offers various automation solutions, including no-code development. For enterprise packaged software and Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS), R Systems provides end-to-end support, from advisory consulting, implementation, and customization to cloud migration, system upgrades, data migration and integration, analytics, reporting, and continuous maintenance and managed services. R Systems International Limited is a subsidiary of BCP Asia II Topco II Pte. Ltd.
